title: EnableAmbientParticles - Weather
content:
Member of: Weather Script Enables or disables ambient particle effects coming from the weather. Syntax: Function EnableAmbientParticles(bool abEnable = true) native global Parameters: - abEnable - Whether to enable or disable the effects Return Value: None Examples: ;Disables ambient particles Weather.EnableAmbientParticles(false)
;Enables ambient particles again Weather.EnableAmbientParticles() See Also: Weather Script
